checks.description: relabels every extends edge as implements (the exact multi-interface bug class reported by the owner)
drops edges whose target contains a dot (FQN handling regression)
sets confidence 1.0 on every relationship (silent heuristic inflation, contract §4 violation)
adds a bogus implements edge to package segment 'java' for every class
strips isFieldAccess uses edges (the collector-added feature)
strips qualified_calls from every symbol (the isKotlinBuiltin bug class)
clears comments arrays (kotlin KDoc bug class)
swaps extends <-> implements labels on heritage edges

limitations.description: mutants wrap analyzer output rather than rewriting analyzer source; equivalent at the suite level but not a compiler-level injection
mutation coverage currently spans java + groovy (the wave languages); other languages add mutants when their waves start
